prerequisites: Prior knowledge of the Graphic Expression course

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and represent plans of engineering structures and installations.
Correctly use specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards for the graphical representation of industrial installations.
Customize CAD applications oriented to specific installations and drawings.
Organize and manage CAD systems in companies.
Exchange drawing files between applications and via the Internet.

syllabus_topics: Software CAD / BIM / MEP / Visualization / Animation / Simulation.
BIM systems. Parametric modeling of structures and architecture.
Scientific visualization. Animation and Simulation of 3D models.
Exchange of drawing files between different computer applications.
Principles of dimensioning for industrial installations. Standards.

assessment_methods.method: Exercises, work and/or presentations developed during the course (Individual work)
Active participation of the student in the development of the subject. Correct completion of proposed exercises during the course.

assessment_rules: Students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (classroom and laboratory) to be considered for continuous evaluation. The final grade is calculated as 0.75 * EV2 + 0.25 * EV4. If the minimum attendance is not met, or if the calculated grade is below 4.0 when conditions are not met, the final grade will be 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, students must submit a new or corrected personal project. For differentiated evaluation, students participate via the virtual campus and submit a personal project.
